# Effects API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/effects.json</code></div>

Effect components on entities: particles, volumetric light, reflective surfaces, material shades and fog.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.effects.set`

`set(entity, kind, quality) -> boolean`

Assigns an effect kind and quality to the entity.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `kind` | number | 0 Particles, 1 VolumetricLight, 2 ReflectiveSurface, 3 MaterialShade, 4 Fog; clamped to 4. |
| `quality` | number | 0 Performance, 1 Balanced, 2 Quality; clamped to 2. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.effects.set(e, 0, 1)
```

### `caffeine.effects.particle`

`particle(entity, domain) -> boolean`

Turns the entity into a particle emitter for the given domain.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `domain` | number | 0 Both, 1 2D, 2 3D; clamped to 2. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.effects.particle(e, 2)
```

### `caffeine.effects.particleParams`

`particleParams(entity, rate, lifetime, maxParticles, startSize, endSize, gravityY) -> boolean`

Sets the particle emitter parameters.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `rate` | number | Emission rate. |
| `lifetime` | number | Particle lifetime. |
| `maxParticles` | number | Maximum live particles. |
| `startSize` | number | Size at birth. |
| `endSize` | number | Size at death. |
| `gravityY` | number | Vertical gravity. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.effects.particleParams(e, 30, 2, 200, 0.2, 0.0, -1)
```

### `caffeine.effects.volumetric`

`volumetric(entity) -> boolean`

Makes the entity a volumetric light and ensures its volume mesh.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.effects.volumetric(lamp)
```

### `caffeine.effects.volumetricShape`

`volumetricShape(entity, shape, columns, rows) -> boolean`

Sets the shape of a volumetric light.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `shape` | number | 0 Sphere, 1 Cone, 2 Box, 3 Cylinder, 4 Window; clamped to 4. |
| `columns` | number | Column count. |
| `rows` | number | Row count. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.effects.volumetricShape(lamp, 1, 8, 8)
```

### `caffeine.effects.fog`

`fog(entity, domain, style) -> boolean`

Turns the entity into a fog effect with the given style.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `domain` | number | 0 Both, 1 2D, 2 3D; clamped to 2. |
| `style` | number | 0 Fog, 1 Dust, 2 Mist, 3 Smoke; clamped to 3. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.effects.fog(e, 2, 2)
```
